name: Ethylhexyl hydroxystearate
description: Ethylhexyl hydroxystearate (CAS 29710-25-6 ) is an ester of 12-hydroxystearic acid and 2-ethylhexanol, used across personal care, coatings, and industrial lubrication markets. It functions as an emollient, rheology modifier, and lubricant. The material delivers skin-feel enhancement and processing benefits depending on the specific application. In cosmetic formulations, it acts as a lightweight emollient and spreading agent in skin creams and sunscreens. It is frequently used in color cosmetics, contributing a non-greasy skin feel without heavy residue. Coatings and adhesive formulators incorporate it as a plasticizing ester to improve flexibility and substrate wetting. The product is effective in solvent-based and UV-cure systems. In lubricant compounding, it serves as a base fluid or additive component where low volatility and good lubricity on metal surfaces are required. Its hydroxyl functionality also makes it useful as a dispersant carrier for pigments and actives in both cosmetic and industrial systems. This versatility makes it a staple for diverse chemical manufacturing needs. Ethylhexyl hydroxystearate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the purity requirements of personal care and industrial buyers. Standard packaging includes drums and IBC containers, with bulk options available for high-volume industrial procurement.
